title: Verify conversion from USD to EUR
gherkin:
Feature: Multi-currency conversion integrity
  Scenario: Convert USD to EUR
    Given I have an amount of 100 USD
    When I convert it to EUR
    Then I should receive the correct amount in EUR based on the current exchange rate
rationale: To ensure that the conversion from USD to EUR is accurate and reflects the current exchange rate.
generationSummary: Tests to ensure the integrity of multi-currency conversions in the system.
